title: predicatory-commutation
description: The predicatory comparison asserting that two predication-categorical operations yield the same valuation when composed in either order (F . G = G . F); a commuting-diagram check whose equality is equality of resulting valuations, refining predicatory-comparison.

firstComposite.description: F . G, one of the two composites with common source and target

secondComposite.description: G . F, the other composite with the same source and target

commutes.description: whether the square commutes strictly: F . G = G . F as equality of resulting valuations

commutationDefect.description: when commutation is relaxed rather than strict, a bilattice-valued profile of where the two composites disagree
